meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
Choosing the right formal shirt brand depends on your budget, workplace dress code, and preference for fit.[ghpc.in](https://ghpc.in/blogs/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-2024#:~:text=Factors%20to%20consider%3A%20Budget%3A%20Formal%20shirt%20prices,of%20your%20workplace%20when%20choosing%20a%20style.) Several trusted brands stand out in the Indian market for their quality, durability, and style:

* **Raymond / Park Avenue:** Best for **classic corporate wear and premium fabrics**. Raymond is a heritage name known for sophisticated tailoring and mature styling, while Park Avenue offers polished, contemporary designs that pair seamlessly with suits and blazers.[midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026#:~:text=Park%20Avenue%20is%20suitable%20for%20men%20who,who%20prefer%20smart%20formal%20and%20semi-formal%20shirts.)
* **Van Heusen / Louis Philippe / Arrow:** Best for **sharp, modern business wear**. These brands specialize in crisp silhouettes, wrinkle-resistant technology, and comfortable fabrics well-suited for long office hours and important presentations.[theformalclub.in](https://theformalclub.in/blogs/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india#:~:text=The%20brand%20focuses%20on%20making%20eco-friendly%20shirts,without%20compromising%20on%20fabric%20quality%20or%20style.)
* **Marks & Spencer:** Best for **premium comfort and low-maintenance fabrics**. Their non-iron cotton shirts feature high-quality two-fold weaves that maintain a crisp look throughout the day.[ghpc.in](https://ghpc.in/blogs/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-2024#:~:text=Raymonds%3A%20Renowned%20for%20their%20quality%20fabrics%2C%20tailoring%2C,wear%2C%20while%20still%20maintaining%20a%20professional%20look.)
* **Peter England / Turtle / The Indian Garage Co:** Best for **budget-friendly daily wear**.[theformalclub.in](https://theformalclub.in/blogs/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india#:~:text=Not%20everyone%20wants%20to%20spend%20a%20fortune,wardrobe%2C%20these%20shirts%20are%20a%20smart%20choice.) These brands offer durable cotton blends and clean styles, making them popular choices for freshers, students, and daily office rotation without breaking the bank.[theformalclub.in](https://theformalclub.in/blogs/blog/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india#:~:text=Peter%20England%20strikes%20a%20good%20balance%20between,by%20style-sensitive%20professionals.%20*%208.%20Park%20Avenue.)

This Van Heusen slim-fit shirt offers a **breathable cotton build** and a **sharp profile** ideal for professional settings.

Crafted from **100% pure cotton**, this Raymond shirt delivers a **sleek, streamlined look** with a classic spread collar.

Featuring a **subtle self-design pattern**, this Park Avenue shirt provides a **polished and modern aesthetic** for formal occasions.

This Marks & Spencer option uses **advanced non-iron technology** and **luxurious two-fold cotton** for effortless daily maintenance.

An affordable choice, this The Indian Garage Co shirt combines **lightweight cotton-poly fabric** with a **contemporary cutaway collar**.

This United Colors of Benetton shirt brings a **clean solid design** and **reliable slim fit** suited for business-casual offices.

Made with **pure cotton**, this Turtle shirt balances **comfort and neat tailoring** for everyday professional wear.

If you like, I can narrow down these recommendations based on your specific budget range (such as under ₹1,500 or premium options) and whether you prefer slim or regular fits. Do you want me to do that?
